A BUILD FAULT CAUGHT HERE. The first attempt silently produced the PAGE's filenames from the PAGE's source: both entries were keyed 'firming-skin-density' in BANNERS, and a duplicate key in a Python dict literal is legal - the last one wins, with no error. This one is now keyed 'firming-skin-density-collection', and extend-banner-canvas.py refuses to run if any key is duplicated.
